from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialResult(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data from one company's document."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company or entity")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered (e.g., three months ended March 31, 2024)")
    line_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label as written (e.g., 'Net Loss', 'Net Income')")
    net_result: float | None = Field(description="The numerical amount as reported; losses should be negative")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt of the line item containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_results: list[CompanyFinancialResult]
